leads.Personalized Subject Line: A tawaki's journey home and Simmy's letters
leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi Jeanette,

My name is Femi Emmanuel. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across A Little Blue and Penguins Don't Send Postcards while researching your work. I was particularly interested in Simmy's letters home from the West Coast and the kororā that change how he sees the world, and in the injured tawaki who drifts all the way to the far north before finding his way back home.

Those details gave me an idea for how short book trailers could help present your books to more of the readers who may enjoy them. Using your own illustrations, I picture gentle animated sequences, one following the tawaki along the coastline and one built around Simmy's letters, suited to your YouTube channel and to schools and conservation partners.

I'd be happy to put together a complimentary concept sample so you can see the direction I have in mind.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Femi Emmanuel
